dz: 哈利彗星被约翰·格奥尔格·帕利茨克所看见,证实了埃德蒙·哈利对彗星的通过所作的预测. 这是提前预言的彗星的第一段经过.
de: Halley's Comet is sighted by Johann Georg Palitzsch, confirming Edmund Halley's prediction of its passage.  This was the first passage of a comet predicted ahead of time.

t: J. S. Bach领衔主演了圣诞Cantata Unser Mund sei voll La…

dz: J. S. Bach领衔主演了圣诞Cantata Unser Mund sei voll Lachens, BWV 110,使笑声在歌唱中声入人心.
de: J. S. Bach leads the first performance of the Christmas cantata Unser Mund sei voll Lachens, BWV 110, making laughter audible in singing.

dz: J. S. Bach以路德1524年圣诞颂歌为基础,在莱比锡领衔主演了"克苏基督"(Gelobet seist du, Jesu Christ, BWV 91)的首次演出.
de: J. S. Bach leads the first performance of Gelobet seist du, Jesu Christ, BWV 91, in Leipzig, based on Luther's 1524 Christmas hymn.

t: 教宗皮乌斯四世在前任去世后四个月当选.
te: Pope Pius IV is elected, four months after his predecessor's death.
dz: 教宗皮乌斯四世在前任去世后四个月当选.
de: Pope Pius IV is elected, four months after his predecessor's death.

t: 劳塔罗手下的马普切叛军击败了西班牙征服者并处决了智利总督佩德罗·德·瓦尔迪维亚.
te: Mapuche rebels under Lautaro defeat the Spanish conquistadors and executes the governor of Chile, Pedro de Valdivia.
dz: 图卡佩尔战役:劳塔罗手下的马普切叛军击败了西班牙征服者并处决了智利总督佩德罗·德·瓦尔迪维亚.
de: Battle of Tucapel: Mapuche rebels under Lautaro defeat the Spanish conquistadors and executes the governor of Chile, Pedro de Valdivia.

te: The carrack Santa María, commanded by Christopher Columbus, runs onto a reef off Haiti due to an improper watch.
dz: 由克里斯多夫·哥伦布指挥的卡拉克·圣玛利亚(英语:Carrack Santa María)由于手表不当而跑入了海地外的礁石上.
de: The carrack Santa María, commanded by Christopher Columbus, runs onto a reef off Haiti due to an improper watch.

te: Charles IV, Holy Roman Emperor, promulgates the Golden Bull, a constitution for his empire.
dz: 神圣罗马皇帝查理四世颁布"金牛",为他的帝国制定宪法.
de: Charles IV, Holy Roman Emperor, promulgates the Golden Bull, a constitution for his empire.

te: Eleven-year-old John IV Laskaris of the restored Eastern Roman Empire is deposed and blinded by orders of his co-ruler …
dz: 11岁的被恢复的东罗马帝国的约翰四世·拉斯卡里斯被他同治的迈克尔八世·帕拉伊洛戈斯的命令废黜并蒙蔽了双眼.
de: Eleven-year-old John IV Laskaris of the restored Eastern Roman Empire is deposed and blinded by orders of his co-ruler Michael VIII Palaiologos.

dz: 西西里伯爵罗杰二世被加冕为第一位西西里国王.

dz: 布洛涅的鲍德温被加冕为伯利恒圣诞教堂中第一位耶路撒冷国王.

dz: 征服者威廉(William the Conqueror),诺曼底公爵被加冕为英格兰国王,位于伦敦威斯敏斯特会所.
de: William the Conqueror, Duke of Normandy is crowned king of England, at Westminster Abbey, London.

t: 亨利三世被教宗克莱门特二世加冕为神圣罗马皇帝.
te: Henry III is crowned Holy Roman Emperor by Pope Clement II.
dz: 亨利三世被教宗克莱门特二世加冕为神圣罗马皇帝.
de: Henry III is crowned Holy Roman Emperor by Pope Clement II.

dz: 将米斯兹科二世·兰伯特加冕为波兰国王.
de: Coronation of Mieszko II Lambert as king of Poland.

te: Hungary is established as a Christian kingdom by Stephen I of Hungary.
dz: 匈牙利王国的地基:匈牙利由匈牙利的斯蒂芬一世建立为基督教王国.
de: The foundation of the Kingdom of Hungary: Hungary is established as a Christian kingdom by Stephen I of Hungary.

dz: 东德皇帝利奥五世被迈克尔二世的追随者在君士坦丁堡大宫的一座教堂被谋杀.

dz: 查理曼大帝在罗马加冕为神圣罗马帝国皇帝。
de: The coronation of Charlemagne as Holy Roman Emperor, in Rome.

dz: 韦特拉尼奥在纳伊苏斯(塞尔维亚)与君士坦提乌斯二世相会并被迫放弃他的帝国头衔. 君士坦提乌斯允许他作为私人公民靠国家养老金生活.
de: Vetranio meets Constantius II at Naissus (Serbia) and is forced to abdicate his imperial title. Constantius allows him to live as a private citizen on a state pension.

dz: 最早记载了在罗马庆祝圣诞节的标志.
